purpose: Predict stopwatch TUG and official frailty from a short straight walking cycle; compare speed alone versus speed plus gait/trunk features in the same people.
source: FRAILPOL Figshare article29315771 v3 CC BY4.0; 668 people, five100Hz IMUs; no RGB/full-body joints/GDI.
pilot: 12 fixed people, IDs1/9/source examples,63 extreme slow case,9 seeded random. No prediction inspected. All-axis template missed cycles; gyro units empirically radians/s despite documentation deg/s. External Barth template gyr_ml only used after unit correction. Bilateral-cycle requirement retained only as coverage audit, rejected as primary before modeling (6/12). Single-cycle pilot10/12. Pilot participants retained; sensitivity exclude these12 reported.

extraction.gyro_conversion: raw rad/s multiplied by180/pi; orientation derivative slope required0.8..1.2 in all three used sensors
extraction.template: external gaitmap BarthOriginalTemplate(use_cols=[gyr_ml]), default BarthDtw settings
extraction.window: Earliest-ending single complete min-velocity cycle, duration0.6..3s. Trunk projected heading smoothed sigma5frames; range<=20deg and forward horizontal projection>=0.5.80ms margins either side. Selected once, no search for a better speed after failure. Raw support<=3.17s.
extraction.quality: All3used sensors equal packet counters,no missing/duplicate packets modulo65536,no NaN. Speed0.05..2.5m/s,stride0.1..3m,sensor lift0..1m. Mark failures unmeasurable. No target-based exclusion. Stride speed=horizontal stride length/(end-start), not fullTUG distance/time.
extraction.features: 11 single-ankle descriptors including speed/time/swing fraction/length/lift/lateral excursion/sensor angle range/IC andTC angles/angular velocityRMS/acceleration normSD;8 sacrum acceleration/angular velocity SD descriptors. No global times/counts/record duration,age,sex,site,clinical items,other-window values. One cycle cannot estimate long-term gait variability or reliable bilateral asymmetry.
extraction.limits: No motion capture/speed ground truth; ankle trajectory and phase identification remain exploratory. Whole record used only for outcome-blind localization; feature calculations cropped to selected support. Same-test TUG prediction, not independent-day screening.

targets.tug: Valid positive provider TUG seconds; train log(TUG), exponentiate predictions; no clipping or exclusion of extreme values. MAE seconds primary.
targets.frailty: Official Targets0robust/1pre-frail/2frail; retain even when component sums disagree. Primary logloss; report balanced accuracy,macroF1,confusion,rare-frail recall/PR-AUC.
targets.non_slowness: Secondary numeric sum of Weight loss,Weakness,Physical Activity,Muscular strength (0..4); all5 components present and FI equals5-item sum required; not an official new frailty diagnosis.

split: Sorted participant IDs stratified5fold(seed20261103) by official frailty over all668 before missingness/quality filtering. Same assigned fold across every target/model/condition. Each person once. Inner3fold shuffle20261031 training only, stratifyclass for classification,KFold for regression.
selection: LGBM16grid inner pooled MAE seconds/TUG,MAE4item,logloss3class; first tie. No class weighting or probability recalibration. Fixed foundation8ensemble CPUfloat32,seed20261103,no gradient tuning. Class probabilities argmax; no test threshold selection.
baselines: Training median for regression and training class prevalence probabilities for classification, independent of condition.
metrics: All held-out predictions. Person paired bootstrap10000 seed20261103 conditional fixed predictions; feature-minus-speed MAE(logloss/classification) and BA differences. Age>=65,non-pilot,officialfrailty classes,TUG<8/8..12/12..20/>=20 subgroups descriptive. Report missingness and feature coverage by label/age; show raw-label inconsistencies. No best subgroup claim.
verification: SHA256 input/protocol/weights/code; saved contexts include train/testIDs and features; final LightGBM saved and reloaded; all foundation contexts reconstructed and predicted again; independent inner selection and held-out metrics; raw short-window replay and perturbation outside window; no precision relaxation.
